Dependabot tracks each github/codeql-action SUBPATH (init, analyze) as a separate dependency, so it opens the same upgrade as two PRs. Merging either alone breaks the analyze job — init and analyze MUST run at the same version:

  Loaded a configuration file for version '4.37.9', but running version '4.37.3'
  CodeQL job status was configuration error.

main has NO branch protection, so a split merge goes through green-looking and leaves Leg A static analysis silently misconfigured. Hit 2026-09-04 with #180/#178 (4.37.3->4.37.9); landed as one commit in #181, which also added a dependabot 'groups' block (patterns: github/codeql-action*) so it cannot recur.

GENERALIZES: any action where two subpaths of one repo must version-match needs a groups entry. Contrast softprops/action-gh-release — two USAGES of one dependency, which Dependabot correctly bumps in a single PR.

VETTING A PINNED-SHA ACTION BUMP: tags are annotated, so ref lookup returns a tag object, not the commit. Deref before comparing:
  gh api repos/OWNER/REPO/git/ref/tags/vX.Y.Z --jq .object.sha   # -> tag obj
  gh api repos/OWNER/REPO/git/tags/<that sha> --jq .object.sha   # -> commit
